$meta.comment: Canonical Figma <-> code mapping (ADR-0010). Human-readable view: Architecture.md §3.1. Every entry's code file must carry `// figma: node-id=<nodeId>` in its header. Components are added here in the same PR that creates them (Phase 2+); nodeId values are looked up in Figma dev mode or via MCP at build time.
$meta.status: pre-Phase-2: paths reserved, nodeId filled in when each component is built

Atom/Tag.notes: Figma 'Color' axis → semantic CVA variant: Grey→neutral, Red→urgent, Yellow→medium, Blue→mid, Green→low (matches card priority enum)

Checkbox.notes: Checked=No/Yes prop; fetched node has no 'delete' state — needs triage before a future ticket adds it (#16)

Icon/*.notes: single wrapper around lucide-react@1.25.0+ (upgraded 2026-07-20 for the Broccoli icon, added upstream between v1.14–1.15). Figma layer names are kept in sync with lucide export names (renamed 2026-07-20, refined again same day: Clock→Alarm-clock-check, Cake→Cake-slice, List→Scroll, Folder→Folder-closed, Columns→Columns-3, Cross→X, Calandar typo fixed to Calendar) so IconName is a direct PascalCase lookup — every entry verified against rendered SVG structure, not name alone (caught 2 real bugs this way: Columns was previously mismapped to Columns2, a 2-column/1-divider icon, when Figma's vector has 2 dividers = 3 columns; Cross was previously mapped by literal name to lucide's medical-cross glyph instead of X). UNRESOLVED: Figma layers 'Panel-right-open'/'Panel-right-close' (nodes 3629:126 / 3687:4453) have vector geometry (divider at x=9, i.e. a left-side panel) that verifies against PanelLeftClose/PanelLeftOpen, not PanelRightOpen/PanelRightClose (divider at x=15) — and the open/close pairing also looks swapped relative to the chevron direction. Needs a Figma-side decision (fix the vector, or fix the label) before the code names can follow Figma literally; code currently keeps CloseSidebar/OpenSidebar backed by the geometry-verified PanelLeftClose/PanelLeftOpen.
